title: Keep tests tidy (commercial Mandate 92), in the active contract
goal: Vision: V-17. Directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep tests tidy. The rule lands in core's active contract beside the hermetic-test rules: run the tests a change can break before publishing and fix a test you turned red at once; never skip, ignore, loosen or delete a test to get green; one behavior per test, named and proven; ignores and expected panics say why; deterministic and fast; pin contracts, not incidental numbers; tests go with their code. Clippy's ignore_without_reason and should_panic_without_expect are denied workspace-wide. Pinned in tests/architecture_tests.rs.

reuse.searched: Inside Susi: the active contract already requires hermetic tests, nonempty executed tests and checks scoped to changed crates and dependents; the commercial workflow tests verb (susi-commercial-apps Mandate 92) reports test hygiene and the affected packages. The pinned toolchain's Clippy (1.99.0) has ignore_without_reason and should_panic_without_expect, denied here instead of new code.
